thread_text:
Sam (Customer): Hey team — during month-end reconciliation for ACCT-4721 our dashboard shows 12,345 tokens but the invoice total is 14,890. There's an extra invoice line called `reserved-burst` for 2,490 tokens and invoice shows tier `pro-plus` while dashboard still says `pro`. Can someone help investigate?
Alex (Support): @Sam thanks for the flag. Can you attach the CSV export or a screenshot of the dashboard totals? Any chance there were cross-team credits applied? :eyes: 
Sam (Customer): attaching CSV snippet from our UI export:
```
account_id,period,tokens,plan
ACCT-4721,2026-02,12345,pro
```
Alex (Support): forwarding to billing/finance. @Maria @Prateek can you look at invoice ingest for ACCT-4721? Any backfills or late finalizations during cutoff?
Maria (Finance): pulling invoice: invoice_2026_4721 shows total_tokens=14890. Line items: plan:pro-plus => 12400 tokens, reserved-burst => 2490 tokens. No credit lines present.
Prateek (Billing Eng): reserved-burst looks like something the embed backfill job would add. Can you provide raw meter rows for ACCT-4721 between 2026-02-28 22:30 and 2026-03-01 01:30 UTC?
Sam (Customer): small export from our side (sanitized):
```
2026-02-28T22:58:33Z,ACCT-4721,token_count,500,source=api
2026-02-28T23:05:10Z,ACCT-4721,token_count,2490,source=embed-backfill
2026-03-01T00:02:01Z,ACCT-4721,token_count,11855,source=api
```
Alex (Support): looks like the dashboard query excludes `embed-backfill` sources by default but the invoice pipeline included them. @Maria is that expected?
Maria (Finance): Invoice ingest currently consumes meter rows marked `finalized=true` regardless of source. We have an open change to exclude backfill sources, but it merged after the billing run for February. So the backfill rows were counted on the invoice.
Prateek (Billing Eng): root cause: the backfill job wrote finalized=true for rows with timestamps inside the billing window, so the invoice picked them up. Dashboard hourly rollups are tagging backfill and filtering it out. Short-term options: issue a credit for the 2,490 tokens or reissue corrected invoice. Long-term fix: change backfill to write finalized=false and only flip after post-billing window, and add a safeguard to invoice ingest to ignore `source=embed-backfill` until verified.
Sam (Customer): we prefer a credit. How quickly can that be posted?
Maria (Finance): we'll schedule a credit and corrected invoice by EOD tomorrow pending account owner sign-off. I'll follow up in this thread with confirmation and amounts.
Alex (Support): I'll get account owner sign-off and confirm once credit posts. Thanks for the quick triage all :folded_hands:
billing-bot: invoice generated id=inv_2026_4721 account=ACCT-4721 total_tokens=14890 tier=pro-plus
Prateek (Billing Eng): adding quick repro SQL for engineering to verify duplication:
```
SELECT account_id, source, SUM(tokens) AS tokens
FROM meter_rows
WHERE account_id = 'ACCT-4721'
  AND timestamp >= '2026-02-01' AND timestamp < '2026-03-01'
GROUP BY account_id, source;
```
Alex (Support): @Sam I'll post the credit confirmation here once Finance completes it. If you want a corrected invoice instead, we can do that as well.
Sam (Customer): credit is fine, thanks — appreciate the fast turnaround.
